title: schizanthus tricolor
intro: Schizanthus tricolor, commonly known as the Tricolor or Red and Yellow Flowered Schizanthus, is a flowering plant native to South America. The plant is used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include providing relief from anxiety and stress due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects. The health benefits of Schizanthus tricolor include its ability to promote relaxation, reduce inflammation, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
